lyrics:
[Intro: soft synth chords, muted kick, finger snaps]

[Verse 1: male, plain, conversational]
Class of something, name tag on my jacket
Told myself an hour, then I'd pack it
Then you walked in with that laugh I'd know anywhere
Fifteen years, and you sat down in the same chair

[Pre-Chorus: synths rise, beat builds]
So order what we used to
The cheap one and the fries
Don't tell me what you do now
Tell me lies

[Chorus: both voices, full beat]
So here we are in the car park
With the heater that never worked
Your sister's Honda, the scratched CD
And the song that always skipped
Say nothing's changed
Say we're exempt
We still think we're twenty
We still think we're twenty

[Drop: wordless pitched synth melody, claps, bass]

[Verse 2: female, husky, amused]
Four years gone and a kid called Sunday
Moved away and came back on a Monday
You still wear that awful shirt
I still know the awful words

[Pre-Chorus: synths rise, beat builds]
So order what we used to
The cheap one and the fries
Don't ask me if I'm happy
Tell me lies

[Chorus: both voices, full beat]
So here we are in the car park
With the heater that never worked
Your sister's Honda, the scratched CD
And the song that always skipped
Say nothing's changed
Say we're exempt
We still think we're twenty
We still think we're twenty

[Drop: wordless pitched synth melody, claps, bass]

[Bridge: beat drops out, both voices, quiet]
My knees hurt
Your eyes are tired
It's ten o'clock
We're wired

[Final Chorus: both voices, biggest, synth melody on top]
Say nothing's changed
Say we're exempt
We still think we're twenty
We still think we're twenty

[Outro: synth melody alone, a CD skipping, stop]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 95 BPM, 4/4, A-flat major. A relaxed, mid-tempo electronic pulse. Nostalgic and a little tipsy.

VOICE: A man with a plain, untrained, slightly flat speaking-singing voice, close and conversational. A woman with a husky, textured voice and a catch in it. They take a verse each and sing the choruses together in unison, not in polished harmony.

INSTRUMENTS: Soft, warm synthesiser chords. A simple, pitched synth lead that plays a wordless tune after each chorus, the song's main hook. A muted kick and finger snaps in the verses, a fuller beat with claps in the chorus. A deep, round sub-bass. A gentle piano doubling the chords.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, synth chords and snaps. 0:10 Verse 1, the man. 0:30 Pre-chorus. 0:45 Chorus 1, both voices. 1:10 Drop, the synth melody. 1:30 Verse 2, the woman. 1:50 Pre-chorus. 2:05 Chorus 2. 2:30 Drop. 2:50 Bridge, the beat out, four quiet lines. 3:00 Final chorus, the last four lines with the synth melody on top. 3:20 Outro, the melody alone and the sound of a skipping CD at 3:28.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2010s pop-EDM: soft, rounded and clean, vocals dry and upfront, a gentle drop instead of a hard one.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The wordless synth melody at 1:10.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original pair are in their twenties pretending they will never age. These two are at a reunion with sore knees and tired eyes at ten o'clock, and the pretending is a kindness they do for each other.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Wariness, recognition, shared make-believe, a rueful laugh.
